name: ignore-doctor
description: Audit repository ignore boundaries for leaks and context bloat.

scripts.check: node --check bin/ignore-doctor.js && node --check bin/action.js && node --check src/analyzer.js && node --check src/reporters.js
scripts.demo: node bin/ignore-doctor.js examples/leaky-repo --format html --output ignore-doctor-report.html --fail-on none
